defects.detail: The skill name 'markdown lint' contains a space, violating the [a-z0-9-] pattern for valid names.
A paragraph explaining what Markdown headings are (starting with 'Markdown headings are created using...') is included. This explains a fundamental concept that any competent agent knows.
The Quick Start section references 'scripts/fix_tables.py' in the command, but this script does not exist in the scripts/ directory (only lint.py is present).
